# Marky v1.2.4

### Highlights & New Features

- **Marketing Website & Release Hub**: Added the official Marky web landing page (`website/`) with live GitHub release asset detection, responsive design, interactive graph playground preview, dark/light theme support, and Docker/Nginx configuration.
- **BiDi / RTL Blockquote Direction in Live Preview**: Fixed quote borders in Live Preview mode to maintain unbroken alignment on the RTL side for Persian/Arabic/RTL text, including empty blockquote delimiter lines (`>`).

### Release Versioning

- Updated the app, Tauri, Cargo, and README versions to `1.2.4`.
